name: Johannesburg Art Gallery
known: Khwezi Gule has been chief curator since 2019 (Wikipedia).

name: Wits Art Museum
known: Chris Seabrooke is chief executive of Sabvest Capital, which he founded in 1988 (Wits).

name: National Arts Festival
known: CEO Monica Newton hands over to Palesa Kadi after the 2026 edition (Mail & Guardian, 10 July 2026).
The National Arts Festival works in tandem with the Grahamstown Foundation, shares its CEO, and co-produces Scifest Africa and school festivals.

name: Javett Art Centre at the University of Pretoria (Javett-UP)
Voortrekker Monument
known: Gerard Moerdijk's monument stands in a nature reserve with a 20,000-seat amphitheatre from 1949; retired Major General Gert Opperman led it as CEO from 2000.

name: Busan Museum of Art
known: Curatorial dispute, Sept 2026: Korea Economic Daily called its reopening exhibition on defector and socialist-affiliated artists one-sided.

name: Busan Museum of Contemporary Art
known: Kim Seongyoun became first director on 11 May 2017 and Kang Seungwan second director on 27 June 2022 (museum site).

name: Changwon Sculpture Biennale
known: 7th edition, "Silent Apple" (Artbava's English title), 27 September to 10 November 2024, artistic director Hyeon Seewon: 86 artists and collaborators from 16 countries, 177 works including 47 new commissions, and 107,710 visitors, about 20% more than in 2022 (Newsgn, 12 November 2024).

8th edition, "Resonance Field", 30 September to 15 November 2026, with co-artistic directors Cho Hye-jung and Zhang Jun, the first Korea and China co-direction in the biennale's history. 74 teams and 81 artists (Hankook Sotong Today, 30 September 2026).

name: Cheongju Craft Biennale
known: Organised by the Cheongju Craft Biennale Organizing Committee, chaired by Cheongju Mayor Lee Beom-seok.
The executive director is Byun Kwang-seop (The City Maker).
The committee is chaired by the mayor of Cheongju, and city culture officials attended the 2025 results meeting (The City Maker).
Run by the Cheongju Craft Biennale Organizing Committee, chaired by the city mayor, with the Culture Factory as its main venue.

name: Gwangju Biennale
known: Governed by the Gwangju Biennale Foundation, whose board seats the directors of the Gwangju Museum of Art and Gwangju Media Platform and the artistic director of SONGEUN.

name: Sun Mu Studio & North Korean Dissident Art Archive
Alternative Space LOOP
known: Director Ji Yoon Yang joined as a curator in 2006 and became director in autumn 2017 (Whitewall, Katy Donoghue, 20 November 2024).
Programme: exhibitions, an annual open call for artists and independent curators, and research and workshops.

Director Yang says board members and other members sponsor LOOP monthly, which she says makes it more stable; she calls it a middle-sized organisation with a stronger public role than at the start (Whitewall, 2024).
Its Support page names its chairs, directors, auditor and 44 individual donors, undated.
